searchText: implementers call now: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82763999854?pwd=Uy9sR1ZxeUJhc0crckFKanV5VERCdz09 Is there another call around the same time tomorrow, or do I have the date wrong on that and that call is today? Hm, nothing on my calendar for tomorrow > I have been trying to tweak the discv5 code to make the talkreq api easier to work with. So far, I haven't been able to think of a good solution > I'm hacking some code here https://github.com/pawanjay176/trin/tree/discv5 and https://github.com/pawanjay176/discv5/tree/trin <@!689161464829050960> <@456226577798135808> this is the discv5 hack project I mentioned on the call Quick call notes: - existing discv5 rust implementation needs a little work to better support TALKREQ/RESP API (Sam and maybe ftruzzi are going to look into that) - status has candidates in the pipe and are having forward progress with getting their position filled - expecting it to take a few weeks here to really get moving and get these new implementations off the ground. > the issue is that the way discv5 rust handles talkreq messages is a bit limiting. Currently, it uses a pure function callback we can define which takes (request, protocol) bytes and returns the response. This doesn't work for our usecase where we need access to the discv5 dht to respond to FindNode requests (so it can't be a pure function). Also I think there hasn't been much thought put into the talkreq api (atleast in rust) because nobody uses it yet <@!119818938845495298> can you drop a link to the macos work that you've done to make a little menu bar "thingy" for Trin to live in? There's a workable implementation in the DDHT (python) codebase that you might be able to take queues from on how it can/could be shaped (all background quotes by <@!491624610215886849> ) Could you maybe link a bit deeper to a particular class as a starting point? https://github.com/ethereum/ddht/blob/1d3b554af8ff93f5cd24b9251712384ff53cd330/ddht/v5_1/network.py#L486-L503 and where it's used: https://github.com/ethereum/ddht/blob/1d3b554af8ff93f5cd24b9251712384ff53cd330/ddht/v5_1/alexandria/client.py#L134-L191 nothing shareable for macOS yet, just been learning the ropes. its priority #3 or 4 these days, but that can change as needed. <@!364458974906548225> fyi i've also been logging notes here - https://notes.ethereum.org/kva0bUSARI-I2VLx4eb6mw
